digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Parallel surface changes lack enumerated parity census covering CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, and dual-direction reconciliation slots.
Config keys are parsed but behavior changes are not proven through real read paths, allowing miswired read-but-ignored patterns to escape.
Contention cases for composed locked operations, check-then-act patterns, and cache/snapshot behaviors lack systematic routing to existing shared test suites.
Behavioral gate findings are fixed without red tests first, conflating change-detector noise with correctness validation.
Out-of-scope census slots, exclusions, compromises, and deferred findings lack enumerated disposition (filed, accepted, fixed) in Phase 5 reporting.
